title: 第21章 甲乙合同第22章 请神的要点
content_zh:
;;
一路上，竟然是郝科亲自开车，让敖鹏和另外一个陈同学坐在后面。
从这一点上也可以看出民调局这个新兴部门的不同。
因为这两个月民调局做了一个调查，发现游戏者中十多岁到二十几岁的年轻人占据绝大多数。
而民调局本身无法改变游戏参与者的年龄，所以就只能改变自己，于是民调局内部的一些操作流程也迅速改变。
从其他部门调过来的骨干可以不是游戏玩家，但一定要懂怎么和年轻人打交道。
就像敖鹏猜想的。
民调局并不是要压榨年轻人。
这是一个很简单的道理。
第一，你压榨狠了，年轻人有腿，自己知道跑，你不可能全杀了吧。
第二，旧土游戏内玩家的实力现在虽然还没有上升到影响国家层次的地步，但是未来一定会决定国家的实力。
你压榨狠了，反而是在剥削帝国的未来，属于竭泽而渔。
相反，为了帝国的未来，民调局反而会给愿意加入的年轻人提供最好的游戏帮助。
“兄弟，你厉害啊，直接从郝叔那里搞到了请假条，要知道我上周的请假条都还没批呢，早知道我也学你一样，先和郝叔谈好条件。”
郝科一边开车，一边吐槽道，“你也不看看你这两个月请了多少假了！我们是行政部门，不是逃课部门！”
陈白雪笑嘻嘻地应了两声，然后对敖鹏说道，“我叫陈白雪，你呢？”
“敖鹏。”
敖鹏也笑着回答，毕竟是以后得同事，他自然不会装高冷。
一路上陈白雪有意和敖鹏聊游戏中的事情，敖鹏既不高冷，但是也不热切，并没有实际上回答他玩到了哪里。
郝科虽然在开车，但是也在暗中观察敖鹏的表现。

老油子。
郝科给敖鹏下了个判断。
敖鹏没有表现出一般大学生的傲气和稚嫩。
反而有一种以前部门里面的老油子味。
“到了。”
郝科将车停在一栋还算是气派的办公大楼前。
大楼外面有身姿挺拔的保安站岗，用护栏围着，里面有巨大的停车场，不仅停着各种公务车，还有敖鹏看不懂的专业设备车。
进了民调局，郝科带着敖鹏来到了第一科的办公室。
这间办公室巨大，但是只有零星的两三个工位有人的痕迹。
郝科笑着解释道，“现在游戏还在初期，局里面招募的玩家也不多，我们科加上我和你，现在也一共只有五个人，因为保密的原因，所以连普通的文员都没有雇佣，所有的文员工作交给我就行。”
和敖鹏想的一样，大多数年轻人和社会的老油条现在还在迟疑，毕竟大家都想着唯我独法，逍遥自在。

Along the way, it was Hao Ke who drove the car himself, letting Ao Peng and another classmate Chen sit in the back.
From this point we can also see the difference in the emerging department of the Polling Bureau.
Because the polling bureau conducted a survey in the past two months and found that young people in their teens to twenties account for the vast majority of gamers.
The polling bureau itself cannot change the age of the game participants, so it can only change itself. As a result, some internal operating procedures of the polling bureau also quickly changed.
The key players transferred from other departments may not be gamers, but they must know how to deal with young people.
Just like Ao Peng guessed.
The poll bureau is not out to exploit young people.
This is a very simple truth.
First, you are squeezing them too hard. Young people have legs and know how to run away. You can’t possibly kill them all.
Second, although the strength of players in the old land game has not yet risen to the point of affecting the national level, it will definitely determine the strength of the country in the future.
If you squeeze too hard, you are exploiting the future of the empire and fishing for the best.
On the contrary, for the future of the empire, the polling bureau will provide the best game help to young people who are willing to join.
"Brother, you are amazing. You got the leave application form directly from Uncle Hao. You know, my leave application form last week has not been approved yet. If I had known, I would have followed your example and negotiated the terms with Uncle Hao first."
Hao Ke complained while driving, "Don't look at how much leave you have taken in the past two months! We are an administrative department, not a truancy department!"
Chen Baixue responded twice with a smile, and then said to Ao Peng, "My name is Chen Baixue, what's yours?"
"Ao Peng."
Ao Peng also smiled and replied. After all, he would be a colleague in the future, so he would naturally not pretend to be aloof.
Along the way, Chen Baixue intended to chat with Ao Peng about things in the game. Ao Peng was neither aloof nor eager, and did not actually answer where he was playing.
Although Hao Ke was driving, he was also secretly observing Ao Peng's performance.
Old man.
Hao Ke made a judgment for Ao Peng.
Ao Peng did not show the arrogance and immaturity of ordinary college students.
Instead, it smells like old oil from the previous department.
"Arrived."
Hao Ke parked the car in front of a fairly impressive office building.
There are tall and straight security guards standing guard outside the building, surrounded by guardrails. There is a huge parking lot inside, where not only various official vehicles are parked, but also professional equipment vehicles that Ao Peng cannot understand.
After entering the polling bureau, Hao Ke took Ao Peng to the office of Section 1.
This office is huge, but there are only two or three scattered workstations with signs of people.
Hao Ke explained with a smile, "The game is still in its early stages, and there are not many players recruited in the bureau. Our department, including you and me, has only five people in total. Because of confidentiality reasons, we don't even hire ordinary clerks. Just leave all the clerk work to me."
As Ao Peng thought, most young people and social veterans are still hesitant. After all, everyone wants to have their own way and be carefree.
